data.title: Advanced Ratio Reasoning: Equivalent Proportions and Unit Rates
data.description: Engage in critical analysis of proportional relationships by scaling complex real-world contexts including chemical solutions, high-speed transit, bulk commercial pricing, and architectural map scaling.

challenges.instruction: The base ratio is 4 to 25 (Acid (mL) to Distilled Water (mL)). Move the slider to build an equivalent ratio where Distilled Water (mL) is 87.5.
challenges.hint: Compare the target with the base value in the same row: how many times bigger is it? Slide to that multiplier.
